name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Solution Consulting | Strategic Discovery, Solution Proposals, AI Fluency & Sales Partnership
summary: Consultative seller and solution designer with 15+ years in customer-facing SaaS, agency, and operations roles, turning a customer's business problem into a clear solution, a scoped plan, and a proposal leadership can approve. At Accelo, ranked top three in sales while quota roughly doubled, leading discovery with C-suite stakeholders, scoping CRM and project-management solutions, and building sequenced implementation plans for delivery teams. At Wix, built sales training for tenured account executives and led a team of 20, so learning and workforce enablement are familiar ground. Builds and deploys AI agents and LLM workflows today, and uses AI tools daily for research, analysis, and solution design.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead discovery with business owners and their teams to map objectives, constraints, stakeholders, and success criteria, then design and propose the solution.
Architect and deploy AI agents and LLM workflows, breaking manual processes into agent logic and translating business intent into reliable AI output.
Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, analysis, proposal drafting, and solution design, and built rubric-based evaluation to keep AI output accurate.
Scope complementary services to expand engagements, tying each proposal to measurable outcomes.
Lead onboarding and hands-on training for every new technology stack so solutions are adopted, not just delivered.
